notes.title: October 27, 2022 Update Notice (+add )
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305747/71957dae04955b4e9ea2a805aa655f64971638d7.png[/img]
[h3][b][Update][/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*]Modify Balance
[list]
[*]Arthur: Less cool time for special move.
[*]Tristan: Increasing the range of general attacks and increasing the knockback effect of special move
[*]Priscilla: Reduces cool time of general attacks, increases special move power
[*]Theodore: Reduces cool time and increases attack power at a certain level
[*]Leah: Increase attack power of general attack and reduce cool time of special skill and increase attack power
[*]Sethia: Increase the size of the shield and reduce the cool time of the special move
[*]Hubert: special skill attack power up
[*]Winesette: Reduces cool time of special move
[*]Himekuma Ribon: Reduces cool time of general attacks
[*]AmamaNia: Reduces cool time for special move and increased speed of bullet
[/list]
[*]Additional effect on some conditions or more
[list]
[*]Teddy Bear Invaders, Twisting Vines and Ice Attacks Give Additional Effects When Freezing Conditions Occurred
-> During this effect, resistance to some attacks by enemies and air attributes are removed
-> Add 1.5 times the damage received if the condition is abnormal due to the twisting vines
[/list]
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305747/13bc7c4bde90025e3fcd04a8265f877463d44d59.png[/img]
[h3][b][Bug fix][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Correction of a problem where the speed of some projectiles of attack was abnormally applied during dash use
[*]Correction of the problem that Byakko Akine Join Quest is marked as disabled
[*]Correction of the problem in which characters displayed on the world map are marked as DLC characters during the tutorial
[*]Correct an issue where not all text is displayed
[*] Fixed an issue where a quest after joining occurs when Byakko Akine is not part of the party under certain circumstances
[/list]

[h3][b][Checking other things][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]When proceeding with NEW GAME+, a quest after joining occurs without Byakko Akine joining the party
[/list]

notes.title: Updates and bug fixes for July 28, 2022

[*]Add Cuontama DLC

- In the event of a collision with the boss, if one of our troops falls, the boss will immediately step back

- Add boss maximum number limit by score zone

- Add a description for each controller

"We are very glad to announce that we will release "The Lord of the Parties" on June 30, 2022.

Please wait for a little while until we release the game.
"

notes.title: Release Will Be Delayed
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305747/3833b44ebcdbe1979f58921c74e80e48fc49a2e1.png[/img]

"We must announce that the release of [i]The Lord of the Parties[/i] has been postponed to Spring of 2022.

We have made the judgement that further polishing is necessary to meet everyone's expectations.

We deeply apologize to keep you all waiting.
Thank you for your understanding and support."
